# KokonutUI - Component Registry Index

Collection of 78 UI components free and open source built with Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, and Motion.

Install any component with: npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/<component-name>

Agents can also browse and install components through the shadcn MCP server
(npx shadcn@latest mcp) once the @kokonutui registry is configured in
components.json. Setup guide: https://kokonutui.com/docs/agents

The documentation index for LLMs lives at https://kokonutui.com/llms.txt

## Components

- [Account Menu](https://kokonutui.com/docs/navigation/profile-dropdown.md): An account card that morphs into its own menu, with account switching, status, theme and hold-to-sign-out. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/profile-dropdown`
- [Activity Terrain](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/activity-terrain.md): A contribution heatmap that tilts up into a 3D terrain you can turn, built with React and canvas. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/activity-terrain`
- [AI Autocomplete](https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-autocomplete.md): A text box that suggests how your sentence ends in grey after the caret. Tab takes it all, the right arrow takes one word, and typing the same letters keeps it. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/ai-autocomplete`
- [AI Context Meter](https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-context-meter.md): How full the context window is, as a ring in the prompt footer that opens a breakdown by source and compacts when it fills. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/ai-context-meter`
- [AI Diff Review](https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-diff-review.md): A coding agent's edits streaming in file by file, then reviewed per file with accept, reject and undo. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/ai-diff-review`
- [AI Inline Citations](https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-citations.md): An answer with source chips beside each claim. One preview glides between chips and lights up the sentence it backs. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/ai-citations`
- [AI Input Search](https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-input-search.md): AI search input with Quick and Research modes and a live trace underneath that stacks each source as it is read, times the run and opens into the full source list. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/ai-input-search`
- [AI Input Selector](https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-prompt.md): AI chat input with a model menu, a separate Effort control, file chips you can drop or paste, a / command menu, and Stop while replying. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/ai-prompt`
- [AI Model Selector](https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-model-selector.md): Pick a model and how hard it thinks. Effort is a detent track that reshapes for each model and keeps your level when you switch. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/ai-model-selector`
- [AI State Loading](https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-loading.md): Agent progress as a list of steps with a live log, elapsed time and a summary when done. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/ai-loading`
- [AI Text Loading](https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-text-loading.md): AI thinking text with a soft wave through the letters and words that swap letter by letter. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/ai-text-loading`
- [AI Tool Approval](https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-tool-approval.md): Approve or deny an agent's tool calls. Destructive calls need a press and hold, and decided calls fold into a trace with their output. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/ai-tool-approval`
- [AI Voice](https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-voice.md): Voice input with a scrolling waveform, then a take you can play back, discard or send. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/ai-voice`
- [Apple Activity Card](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/apple-activity-card.md): Activity rings that draw with a count-up, lap past 100% with a shadowed end cap and dim to focus, built with React and Motion. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/apple-activity-card`
- [Avatar Picker](https://kokonutui.com/docs/inputs/avatar-picker.md): Generated avatars from a name, morphing as you type, on a 3D coin you can flick, tap or shuffle. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/avatar-picker`
- [Background Paths](https://kokonutui.com/docs/backgrounds/background-paths.md): A ribbon of lines in one color that keeps flowing at any size and parts around the cursor. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/background-paths`
- [Bell Button](https://kokonutui.com/docs/buttons/bell-button.md): A subscribe button whose bell swings and rings, with a clapper that really strikes. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/bell-button`
- [Changelog](https://kokonutui.com/docs/changelog.md): New and updated Kokonut UI components, release by release, with a link to each component and its pull request. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/changelog`
- [Clip Trimmer](https://kokonutui.com/docs/media/clip-trimmer.md): A video trim timeline with a filmstrip, handles that snap to whole seconds and a playhead that loops the kept range. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/clip-trimmer`
- [Command Button](https://kokonutui.com/docs/buttons/command-button.md): Keyboard shortcut button with a Command icon, hover shimmer sweep, and smooth CSS transitions, built with React and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/command-button`
- [Command Palette](https://kokonutui.com/docs/navigation/action-search-bar.md): ⌘K command palette with nested pages, fuzzy matching and in-row progress for running actions. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/action-search-bar`
- [Cradle Text](https://kokonutui.com/docs/texts/cradle-text.md): A headline hung like a Newton's cradle, so a knock on one letter clacks through the word, built with React and pendulum physics. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/cradle-text`
- [Currency Transfer](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/currency-transfer.md): Transfer tracker that converts the amount in place, walks through each step on a filling rail, and ends with a copyable reference. Built with React and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/currency-transfer`
- [Detent Dial](https://kokonutui.com/docs/inputs/detent-dial.md): Rotary knob that clicks from notch to notch and coasts when flicked, built with React and Motion. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/detent-dial`
- [Dot Field](https://kokonutui.com/docs/backgrounds/dot-field.md): A halftone dot membrane that ripples behind a swipe and rings out from a click, built with React and Canvas. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/dot-field`
- [Drape Background](https://kokonutui.com/docs/backgrounds/drape-background.md): A pleated curtain in a breeze that you can push and pull, built with React, WebGL and a cloth simulation. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/drape-background`
- [Dynamic Text](https://kokonutui.com/docs/texts/dynamic-text.md): Morphing text where shared letters travel, old ones fall and new ones land, with decode and cycle modes. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/dynamic-text`
- [Extruded Text](https://kokonutui.com/docs/texts/swoosh-text.md): Zinc 3D extruded text lit by your pointer, with letters that press in like keycaps. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/swoosh-text`
- [File Upload](https://kokonutui.com/docs/inputs/file-upload.md): Drag and drop file upload with animated progress, file validation and error states. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion animations. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/file-upload`
- [Flick Card](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/card-flip.md): A two-sided card you spin with a drag or a flick, with thickness, light and a floor shadow that follow the angle. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/card-flip`
- [Focal Point Picker](https://kokonutui.com/docs/media/focal-point-picker.md): Set where a photo's subject is and see every crop follow it live. Hover a crop to see what it cuts. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/focal-point-picker`
- [Glitch Text](https://kokonutui.com/docs/texts/glitch-text.md): Flat text that cuts into hard-shifted bands with a thin red/cyan split, on idle, hover or text change. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/glitch-text`
- [Gradient Button](https://kokonutui.com/docs/buttons/gradient-button.md): Layered gradient button with emerald, purple, and orange variants, a gradient border in light and dark mode, soft inner glow, press feedback, and an optional icon, styled entirely with Tailwind CSS in React. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/gradient-button`
- [Halftone Background](https://kokonutui.com/docs/backgrounds/halftone-background.md): Any image, or a lit sphere, printed as a halftone dot screen, with a loupe that looks closer under the cursor, built with React and canvas. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/halftone-background`
- [Hold Button](https://kokonutui.com/docs/buttons/hold-button.md): Press-and-hold confirmation button with an animated progress fill, configurable hold duration, and color variants, built with React and Motion. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/hold-button`
- [Lightbox Grid](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/lightbox-grid.md): A photo grid whose thumbnails grow into a full view and fly back to their slot when you drag them down. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/lightbox-grid`
- [Liquid Gauge](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/liquid-gauge.md): A usage meter filled with liquid that sloshes, ripples and bubbles, built with React and a wave simulation. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/liquid-gauge`
- [Liquid Slider](https://kokonutui.com/docs/inputs/liquid-slider.md): A vertical slider you fill like a glass, with a sloshing surface and rising bubbles. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/liquid-slider`
- [Loader](https://kokonutui.com/docs/inputs/loader.md): Animated loading indicator with rotating gradient rings, size variants and customizable title text. Built with React and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/loader`
- [Magnet Button](https://kokonutui.com/docs/buttons/attract-button.md): Magnetic button that pulls floating particles to its center on hover using Motion spring animations, built with React and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/attract-button`
- [Marking Menu](https://kokonutui.com/docs/navigation/marking-menu.md): A radial menu you hold to open or flick to pick blind, built with React and Motion. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/marking-menu`
- [Metric Card](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/metric-card.md): A KPI card whose number rolls to any day you scrub, with periods that reshape the line instead of swapping it. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/metric-card`
- [Momentum Rail](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/carousel-cards.md): A card rail you flick with momentum, snapping on a spring, with scroll-driven cover-flow depth and parallax. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/carousel-cards`
- [Morph Popover](https://kokonutui.com/docs/buttons/morph-popover.md): A button that grows into the form it opens, with its label sliding up to become the title, then shrinks into a confirmation. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/morph-popover`
- [Notification Stack](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/notification-stack.md): Stacked notifications that fan out on hover and swipe away, built with React and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/notification-stack`
- [Now Playing](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/liquid-glass-card.md): Music card with a spinning disc you can grab and turn to scrub, built with React and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/liquid-glass-card`
- [Particle Button](https://kokonutui.com/docs/buttons/particle-button.md): Button that bursts animated particles from its center on click with a quick scale press effect, built with React, Motion, and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/particle-button`
- [Photo Straighten](https://kokonutui.com/docs/media/photo-straighten.md): Level a crooked photo on a ruler you drag or flick. The crop grows to hide the corners, and a grid shows while you adjust. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/photo-straighten`
- [Plucked Text](https://kokonutui.com/docs/texts/plucked-text.md): A headline sitting on a string you can pluck, strum and let ring, built with React and real string physics. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/plucked-text`
- [Pull Cord](https://kokonutui.com/docs/buttons/pull-cord.md): A lamp switch you pull on a swinging cord, built with React and a rope simulation. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/pull-cord`
- [Receipt Printer](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/receipt-printer.md): A receipt that prints line by line, then tears off and falls when you pull it, built with React. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/receipt-printer`
- [Scroll Index](https://kokonutui.com/docs/navigation/scroll-index.md): A section rail for long pages, with a tick per heading that you can hover, click or drag to scrub, built with React. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/scroll-index`
- [Shape Hero](https://kokonutui.com/docs/backgrounds/shape-hero.md): A landing hero where shapes drop in, pile up under the headline and can be grabbed and thrown. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/shape-hero`
- [Signature Pad](https://kokonutui.com/docs/inputs/signature-pad.md): A signature field with a sprung pen tip, speed-weighted ink and SVG output. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/signature-pad`
- [Slide Text Button](https://kokonutui.com/docs/buttons/slide-text-button.md): Animated link button with a vertical text slide on hover and default and ghost variants, built with React, Next.js Link, and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/slide-text-button`
- [Smooth Drawer](https://kokonutui.com/docs/navigation/smooth-drawer.md): Bottom drawer with spring-based slide-in and staggered content reveal, built on Vaul with React, Motion, and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/smooth-drawer`
- [Social Button](https://kokonutui.com/docs/buttons/social-button.md): Share button that expands into a row of social icon buttons with staggered Motion animations on hover, built with React and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/social-button`
- [Spending Ring](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/spending-ring.md): A spending breakdown you spin like a dial; flick the ring and it settles with a category under the marker. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/spending-ring`
- [Split Nav](https://kokonutui.com/docs/navigation/morphic-navbar.md): Navigation bar that splits around the active link, with drag-to-scrub, flick projection and an optional compact fold. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/morphic-navbar`
- [Spoiler Text](https://kokonutui.com/docs/texts/spoiler-text.md): Inline text hidden under drifting specks, like a chat spoiler. A click blows the specks away from the point you touched. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/spoiler-text`
- [Stack Panel](https://kokonutui.com/docs/navigation/stack-panel.md): A panel that drills into pages like settings on a phone. The tapped row's label flies up into the title, and a swipe right takes you back. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/stack-panel`
- [Status Island](https://kokonutui.com/docs/navigation/status-island.md): A pill that reports background work, reshaping as tasks change and opening into a list of everything in flight. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/status-island`
- [Swipe Tabs](https://kokonutui.com/docs/navigation/smooth-tab.md): Tabs with a swipeable panel, a drag-tracked indicator and spring physics. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/smooth-tab`
- [Switch Button](https://kokonutui.com/docs/buttons/switch-button.md): Light and dark theme toggle button with a rotating sun icon and shimmer hover effect, built with React and Tailwind CSS. Works on its own or with a theme provider such as next-themes. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/switch-button`
- [Synced Transcript](https://kokonutui.com/docs/media/synced-transcript.md): A transcript that follows the spoken word, lets you click any word to jump there, and waits when you scroll away. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/synced-transcript`
- [Team Selector](https://kokonutui.com/docs/inputs/team-selector.md): Animated team size selector with stacked overlapping avatars, spring transitions and increment controls. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/team-selector`
- [Tear Button](https://kokonutui.com/docs/buttons/tear-button.md): A confirm button you tear off like a ticket stub, hole by hole. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/tear-button`
- [Templates](https://kokonutui.com/docs/templates.md): Full websites built with Kokonut UI, available with Kokonut UI Pro. Open a live preview, or get the source when one fits your project. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/templates`
- [Throw Deck](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/card-stack.md): A pile of image cards you drag, flick off the top and send under the deck, with arrow keys and a details view. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/card-stack`
- [Tool Dock](https://kokonutui.com/docs/navigation/toolbar.md): An editor tool dock with a sliding selection plate, shortcut tooltips and flyouts that you can throw to any edge. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/toolbar`
- [Topo Background](https://kokonutui.com/docs/backgrounds/topo-background.md): A living contour map that drifts, rises under the cursor and ripples on click, built with React and Canvas. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/topo-background`
- [Typing Text](https://kokonutui.com/docs/texts/type-writer.md): Typewriter text that makes the odd typo and corrects it, erases by selecting, and blinks its caret only when idle, built with React and Motion. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/type-writer`
- [Undo Button](https://kokonutui.com/docs/buttons/undo-button.md): An action button that gives you a few seconds to take it back, with the time left drawn around its own edge. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/undo-button`
- [Uptime Card](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/uptime-card.md): A status page card with 90 days per service that swell under the cursor, and a day you click opens its incident log. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/uptime-card`
- [V0 Button](https://kokonutui.com/docs/buttons/v0-button.md): Open in v0 button that sends a component registry JSON to v0.dev for instant editing, built with React, the shadcn Button, and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/v0-button`
- [Wheel Picker](https://kokonutui.com/docs/inputs/wheel-picker.md): iOS-style 3D drum picker with flick momentum, built with React and Motion. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/wheel-picker`
- [Widget Grid](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/bento-grid.md): Dashboard widgets you lift, drag and resize on a 6-column grid, with spring physics and full keyboard support. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/bento-grid`
- [Wind](https://kokonutui.com/docs/backgrounds/flow-field.md): Streamlines that part around the cursor, swirl in its wake and scatter on click, built with React and Canvas. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/flow-field`

Templates and premium components are available on the premium version of Kokonut UI.
https://kokonutui.pro/templates

Premium components are available on the premium version of Kokonut UI.
https://kokonutui.pro/components
